description: On Android, the app's own page may open the pairing scanner through pair_scan and close it through pair_scan_cancel (HAL-12246). The shell drives the barcode-scanner plugin from Rust with fixed options: QR codes only, the back camera, the camera on only while the scanner is open. The page gets only a pairing code's text, never the plugin's commands. It is local only, so the Studio the computer serves gets no camera.
